purpose: Provenance only. This registry changes no physics decision, method, threshold, selection, formula, result, or publication decision.

history_model.historical_history: The production and pair-analysis commits belong to the authenticated historical archive history. The archive is generation evidence only and is not a runtime dependency.
history_model.rebuild_history: The public rebuild has fresh history and intentionally contains no historical production or analysis Git objects.
history_model.projection_boundary: The rebuild root is a source projection from the named historical source commit. Git ancestry does not cross this boundary. Exact data-plane identities below authenticate the one accepted campaign without importing or connecting histories.

archive_generation_evidence.ancestry_path_definition: newline-terminated identities from git rev-list --ancestry-path --reverse --topo-order RAW..ANALYSIS; RAW is excluded and ANALYSIS is included
